intro: Top of the Service accounts tab of Settings › People. A service account is a non-human account for an external agent or script. {{header}} is an HTTP header sample (Authorization: Bearer …), never translated; keep the tags. "socios" are Socio's AI agents.
list.kind: Shown after an account's name, lowercase: says it is a service account, not a person.
list.disabled: Shown after a disabled account's name: "disabled" and the date.
list.role: Screen-reader label of the select that changes an account's role; {{name}} is the account's name.
list.actions: Screen-reader label of the ⋯ menu button of an account; {{name}} is its name.
list.disable: Menu item that opens a confirmation to disable the account; the ellipsis says a confirmation follows.
keys.label: Screen-reader label of an account's table of API keys; {{name}} is the account's name.
keys.madeBy: Column heading: the person who made the key.
keys.actions: Hidden column heading (screen readers only) over the Revoke and Delete buttons.
keys.unknownMaker: Stands in for the name of the person who made a key when that person is no longer known.
keys.creatorGone: Small badge after the key maker's name: that person is deactivated or gone. Lowercase.
keys.creatorGoneHint: Tooltip of the "creator gone" badge: the key keeps working even though its maker left.
keys.date: The date a key was made.
keys.usedAt: The date and time of a key's last request.
keys.usedFrom: Under the last-used time: the IP address the last request came from; {{ip}} is the address.
keys.neverUsed: Last-used column when a key has never been used. Lowercase, like a table value.
keys.revoked: Expiry column of a revoked key: "revoked" and the date.
keys.expires: Expiry column of a live key: the date it stops working.
keys.expired: Expiry column of a key past its expiry date.
keys.revoke: Button: ends a live key at once; it can't be undone.
keys.delete: Button on a revoked key: removes its record for good, after a confirmation.
keys.deleteLabel: Screen-reader label of the Delete button; {{name}} is the key's name.
add.namePlaceholder: Example name for a new service account: "Claude" is an AI assistant's name and "lead" its role; keep the names, translate "Name, e.g.".
newKey.title: Title of the dialog that makes an API key; {{name}} is the service account's name.
newKey.copyNow: Security wording: the key's value appears only now and can't be shown again. Keep this precise.
newKey.created: Shown with the new key's value; {{key}} is the key's name, {{account}} the service account's.
newKey.token: Screen-reader label of the read-only field holding the new key's value.
newKey.namePlaceholder: Placeholder of the key name field: suggests naming the key after the machine or service that uses it.
newKey.lifetime: Screen-reader label of the select of how many days the key lives.
newKey.days: An option of the key lifetime select: a number of days.
scopes.issuesRead: What the issues:read permission allows: reading the Improvements board's issues.
scopes.issuesWrite: What the issues:write permission allows. "File issues": create (report) new issues.
scopes.pagesRead: What the pages:read permission allows. "Space" is a product noun (a shared area for a team's pages and chats).
disable.title: Title of the confirmation before disabling a service account; {{name}} is its name.
disable.body: Disabling revokes every key of the account at once; what it filed (issues, comments) stays.
deleteKey.body: Confirmation text. {{key}} is the key's name, {{prefix}} the start of its value (an identifier, keep the tags), {{account}} the service account's name. The audit log still records who deleted the key.
